description: This file defines extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure and set up ExampleStorage components within an Orleans project. It registers storage factory services and attribute mappers as dependencies.

classes.name: ExampleStorageExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for setting up ExampleStorage in an Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: UseExampleStorage
methods.description: Configures services for ExampleStorage by registering factory and attribute mapper services.

methods.name: UseAsDefaultExampleStorage
methods.description: Sets a specific storage factory type as the default for ExampleStorage.
